title: Utopia Skills index
description: Machine-readable index of every skill shipped in the marketplace. Generated by scripts/build-skills-index.mjs — never hand-edited. See docs/skills-index.md for field stability guarantees.

count.description: Number of entries in `skills`. Always equals skills.length.

name.description: Skill name. Stable — always equals its folder name under skills/<module>/.

module.description: Which of the 4 shipped modules this skill lives under. Stable.

pack.description: Which plugin/pack (from packs.config.json) installs this skill, e.g. 'utopia-gtm'. Null if the skill exists on disk but isn't listed in any pack yet. Not stable — a skill can move packs without notice.

description.description: The skill's frontmatter description (trigger-condition text). Not stable — rewritten over time as descriptions improve.

version.description: metadata.version from frontmatter, if the skill declares one. Null otherwise. Not all skills version themselves.

url.description: Permalink to the skill's SKILL.md on GitHub main. Stable in shape, but 'main' branch content changes over time.
